axioms.name: Experimental.P06_06.weight_terms_summable
axioms.meaning: Summability of the explicitly defined finite-polynomial exponential terms at every positive y.

axioms.name: Experimental.P06_06.normalized_coefficient_ratio_limit
axioms.meaning: The normalized coefficient ratio tends to the actual highest coefficient a_k.

literal_statement_repair_policy: No repair is silently substituted for the verbatim target.
coverage: Encodes the actual finite coefficient polynomial, exponential coupled weight and actual odd-zeta center. Positivity of the cone, uniform comparison constants, pencil identification and arithmetic rates are not axioms.
remaining: Prove both analytic prerequisites; prove the shifted-functional identity in the actual rational domain, discrete positive ratio infimum/supremum and integral comparison. Construct the Z-pencil and its top-weight derivative, transport inertia/radius, then independently establish the claimed actual multiplier rate.
